description: The CN9000 Series Common Crypto Library Module provides FIPS 140-2 approved cryptographic algorithms for CN9000 Series Encryptors. Based upon OpenSSL the Common Crypto Library provides an Application Programming Interface (API) to support security relevant services.
vendor: Senetas Corporation Ltd, distributed by Gemalto NV (SafeNet)

capabilities: Hash Algorithm: SHA-1, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512
